title: update() with unknown doc_ids raises KeyError
description: Calling `db.update({'int': 9}, doc_ids=[1, 99])` raises `KeyError: 99` when no document 99 exists. IDs that do not exist should be skipped, and the call should return only the IDs it actually updated (here `[1]`). `upsert()` with a `Document` whose `doc_id` is not in the table yet fails the same way instead of inserting it.

title: Query.search() ignores regex flags
description: `Query().val.search(r'JOHN', flags=re.IGNORECASE)` does not match `{'val': 'john'}`. The `flags` argument has no effect.

title: IDs are not restarted after drop_tables()
description: After `db.drop_tables()` the next inserted document does not get ID 1 again; the counter carries on from the dropped documents (for example 4). Anything that relies on fresh IDs after a drop (plain and explicit-ID inserts, `insert_multiple`, `update` return values) is affected.

title: Non-cacheable queries are cached anyway
description: Queries that report `is_cacheable() == False` (a custom callable query, or `where('val').map(fn)`) still end up in the table's query cache. Results then go stale when `fn` changes behaviour: a search that should now match nothing keeps returning the old match.

title: CachingMiddleware flushes one write too late
description: With `WRITE_CACHE_SIZE = 3`, the third write should flush the cache to the underlying storage. Nothing reaches the storage until a fourth write happens.

title: add() on a string field prepends instead of appending
description: `db.update(add('char', 'xyz'), where('char') == 'a')` stores `'xyza'` instead of `'axyz'`. Adding numbers works.

title: IDs are not restarted after truncate()
description: After `table.truncate()` the next inserted document does not get ID 1; the counter continues from before the truncate (for example 4).

title: freeze() leaves values inside dicts unfrozen
description: `freeze({'a': [1, 2, 3]})` returns a dict whose list value is still a list. Values inside frozen dicts should be frozen as well (tuples), so the result is immutable and hashable.

title: LRUCache reads do not refresh recency
description: With capacity 3, after inserting a, b, c and reading `cache['a']`, inserting d should evict b (the least recently used). It evicts a instead.

title: create_dirs=True does not create missing directories
description: `JSONStorage('/tmp/some/new/dir/db.json', create_dirs=True)` fails with `FileNotFoundError` when the directory does not exist. With `create_dirs=True` the missing parent directories should be created.
